content_data.meeting_title: Content Strategy Alignment for Global Media Insights Platform Launch
agenda_items: Discussion on audience segmentation and tailored messaging
Resource allocation and content calendar planning for initial launch phase
Brainstorming content formats for data-driven reports and analyses
key_decisions: Develop a tiered content approach: thought leadership, case studies, and short-form insights
Establish a quarterly content audit process linked to platform engagement metrics
Prioritize long-form articles and interactive data visualizations for initial content push
Appoint a dedicated content lead for the platform's 'Insights' section
attendees: Dr. Anya Sharma, Head of Content Strategy
Dr. Kenji Tanaka, Lead Data Scientist
Sarah Chen, Product Manager, Global Insights Platform
